verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows are described as a flexible way to automate decisioning and reduce manual review, and Inquiry/Dynamic Flow Templates let ops define screens, verifications, decisioning, and theming per use case — all consistent with configurable, non-engineering verification logic. However, the evidence never explicitly states these are no-code/drag-and-drop tools usable without an engineering deploy, and there is no mention of country-specific requirement configuration or explicit risk-based routing terminology. Missing for 10: explicit no-code workflow builder claims, country-specific rule configuration evidence, explicit risk-based routing/conditional-step documentation, and confirmation that template edits go live without deploys.
